races.paceDynamic: Prophetess Miriam, Nells Princess, and Samba Train will ensure a strong gallop from flag to finish in this extended trip maiden. Samba Train has dual bumper wins and proven stamina, while Prophetess Miriam is a confirmed front-runner returning from a layoff. The sustained pace over 2m6½f will expose stamina limitations and test jumping under pressure. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and hold-up horses who can stay the extended trip and finish through tired legs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Sustained
scenarios.trigger: If all three front-runners go forward and maintain a searching pace throughout
scenarios.body: The extended trip and relentless gallop will find out stamina limitations, setting up horses with proven staying power who can pick up the pieces. Those who can settle and finish strongly will benefit from the collapse of speed horses.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runners go too hard early and tie up in the final half-mile
scenarios.body: The race will become a tactical affair with tired leaders vulnerable to late challengers who conserved energy. Hold-up horses with finishing kicks will thrive off the slow-motion finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Moderate Early Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Samba Train dictates a steady rhythm without serious pressure from the other leaders
scenarios.body: A more even pace will favour horses who can travel kindly in midfield and have a sustained finish rather than a quick turn of foot. Class and experience become more important than pure stamina.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters gets loose and dictates terms without serious challenge
scenarios.body: An uncontested leader could prove hard to peg back over this extended trip, especially with soft ground conditions aiding stamina types. The winner comes from the early pace group.

races.paceDynamic: Tomthescaffolder is the only confirmed front-runner in this 17-runner maiden hurdle and should get an uncontested lead at a sustainable gallop. The prominent horses like State Pension, Splendid Fellow, and Lemmy Caution will track behind but none are aggressive pace-pressers. This sets up a tactical affair where the pace will be steady rather than searching, before quickening from the back straight. Hold-up horses like Glenroyal and Happy Me will benefit most from this shape, as they'll have time to organise their runs and the race will develop into a sprint finish that favours those with tactical speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady and no prominent horse applies serious pressure to Tomthescaffolder.
scenarios.body: The tactical runners get the perfect setup with time to wind up their runs from off the pace. Glenroyal's flat speed and Happy Me's proven hurdle form become decisive assets in a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent horses like State Pension or Splendid Fellow travels strongly and kicks clear approaching the final flight.
scenarios.body: The pace stays controlled but a well-positioned tracker gets first run on the field and holds on. State Pension's recent course form or Splendid Fellow's class edge could prove telling.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Surprise Front Runner
scenarios.trigger: If another horse unexpectedly goes forward early to challenge or pressure Tomthescaffolder's lead.
scenarios.body: The increased pace stretches the field and creates gaps, allowing a closer that normally sits mid-division to capitalize. Hi Ho Idaho's class could shine if others tire from the stronger gallop.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Leader Lasts Home
scenarios.trigger: If Tomthescaffolder gets such an easy time in front that he has enough left to resist late challenges.
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader builds an unassailable advantage and the hold-up horses leave their runs too late. Tomthescaffolder's stamina reserves prove sufficient despite his long absence.

races.paceDynamic: Midnight Jet is the sole confirmed pace-setter and will dictate terms from the front without serious early pressure. Master Haku may track close behind given his front-running style, but the lack of genuine pace pressers means Midnight Jet can control fractions. The sustainable early gallop will set up a proper stamina test in the final 3-4 furlongs on this testing ground. This race shape clearly favours prominent racers and hold-up horses who can stay strongly, while front-runners face tactical disadvantages without the cover of a fierce early pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front-Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Midnight Jet gets soft fractions and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: The Henry De Bromhead runner capitalises on his class edge and penalty-free status to control the race tactically. His proven course form and strong recent Fairyhouse win make him hard to peg back when allowed easy leads.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly pedestrian and stamina becomes paramount
scenarios.body: The ex-French raiders Columbus and Mr Hollywood benefit from their proven staying power and Willie Mullins' expertise with newcomers. Their Group 3 Flat form translates well to this extended trip when the race becomes a stamina test.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Master Haku Penalty Defiance
scenarios.trigger: If Master Haku can stalk and outbattle Midnight Jet in the straight
scenarios.body: The progressive Gordon Elliott runner uses his recent Kilbeggan win momentum and Jack Kennedy's tactical awareness to overcome his penalty. His front-running style gets him into the race while retaining enough for a battle.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Shock Outsider Success
scenarios.trigger: If the market principles fail to handle the testing conditions
scenarios.body: The race falls apart tactically allowing a hold-up horse like Minnatrix to benefit from her bumper form on debut over hurdles. Hood first time and fresh legs from a long break could surprise the penalised favourites.

races.paceDynamic: My Gaffer will lead unopposed early with his front-running style, setting a sustainable tempo over this extended trip. The prominent group of Duty Bound, Elusive Ogie, William Tell, Falco Blitz, Burru and Therellbguddaysyet creates serious congestion behind the leader, particularly dangerous approaching the business end where they'll all be looking for racing room simultaneously. The large hold-up contingent including Watch The Weather, Fiveonefive, Themanintheanorak, King In Love and Royal Soldier will rely on the pace collapsing or finding gaps late. This race shape strongly favours the lone leader My Gaffer and patient hold-up horses who can navigate the prominent traffic jam.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If My Gaffer gets an easy lead and isn't pressured early
scenarios.body: The sustainable pace plays into his stamina strengths and he kicks clear when the prominent pack gets tangled up turning for home. Hold-up horses like Watch The Weather and King In Love pick up the pieces but can't reach the winner.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack goes too hard trying to get at My Gaffer
scenarios.body: The pace collapses in the final half-mile allowing the patient hold-up brigade to sweep past tired leaders. Royal Soldier and Fiveonefive benefit most from their tactical approaches.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the six prominent runners get bunched up and interfere with each other 2-3 out
scenarios.body: The congestion causes multiple horses to lose momentum at the crucial moment, allowing an unimpeded hold-up horse to steal through. Themanintheanorak or Lord Ffrench could capitalize on cleaner passages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Develops
scenarios.trigger: If William Tell or Duty Bound pressure My Gaffer early
scenarios.body: The faster tempo sets up perfectly for closers but burns out the early leaders completely. Watch The Weather's class tells in a war of attrition finish.

races.paceDynamic: Maxxum is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from flag fall, with prominent runners Jesse Evans, Three Card Brag, and Itsalladream tracking behind. The absence of pace pressure means Maxxum can control fractions and cruise into the straight without being hustled. Gentleman De Mee, Sa Fureur, and The Banger Doyle will be held up in rear, relying on late charges. This sustainable pace setup strongly favours prominent trackers who can position close enough to strike when Maxxum weakens, while hold-up horses face the difficult task of making up significant ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Maxxum sets reasonable fractions and prominent runners position perfectly
scenarios.body: The tracking pack gets first run on the leader turning in, with Jesse Evans and Three Card Brag best placed to capitalize on their tactical advantage. Maxxum's lack of pressure allows him to kick clear briefly, but class tells in the finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Maxxum Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If the front runner maintains his jumping rhythm and stays strong to the line
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows Maxxum to dictate ideal fractions and kick clear at the business end. His recent chase form and tactical advantage prove decisive against higher-rated but poorly positioned rivals.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Charge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish from the last
scenarios.body: Gentleman De Mee and Sa Fureur unleash devastating late runs from their patient holds-up positions. Their superior class ratings and finishing kicks overwhelm the pace-advantaged runners in a thrilling climax.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos At The Fences
scenarios.trigger: If jumping errors or falls disrupt the tactical picture and change the complexion
scenarios.body: Multiple mistakes or fallers create an entirely different race dynamic, allowing outsiders like Senecia or The Banger Doyle to benefit. The race becomes a test of jumping accuracy rather than pure tactical positioning.

watchPoints.text: Maxxum's jumping under pressure - any early mistakes could surrender his crucial tactical advantage and change the entire race dynamic.
Jesse Evans' recovery from his disappointing run just 12 days ago - fitness levels will determine if he can capitalize on his ideal position.
Three Card Brag's ability to handle the trip reduction from his usual staying distances - pace positioning becomes even more critical.
Gentleman De Mee's early positioning with Cobden - needs to avoid being too far back given the likely lack of pace pressure.
The ground conditions holding up through the card - any deterioration could impact the hold-up horses' finishing kicks.

races.paceDynamic: Butty O Brien and Brave Endeavour are the confirmed front runners who will contest the early pace, with Butty O Brien the more reliable of the two given his recent front-running success at Wexford. This duo will create an honest gallop from the start, particularly with 18 runners needing to sort themselves out early. The prominent runners like Rusheen, Sophia Rose, and Ballybrittas will track the leaders closely, while the hold-up horses including Iamagetaway, Thegraveyardbookie, and Oneforgonzo will need the pace to be strong enough to set up their late charges. This race shape strongly favours the prominent racers who can sit handy and strike turning for home, as they avoid the early pace battle while staying close enough to capitalise when the leaders weaken.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the two front runners create genuine pace and weaken in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The honest gallop sets it up perfectly for the prominent runners who can track the pace without getting involved in the early battle, then strike decisively when the leaders tire. Rusheen, Sophia Rose, and Ballybrittas are perfectly positioned to exploit this scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Butty O Brien gets an easy lead and controls the fractions like at Wexford
scenarios.body: His front-running tactics prove too effective for this field, especially with the cheekpieces helping him focus and his recent form suggesting he's well handicapped over this trip. The chasers struggle to reel him in over the final few fences.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely strong and the field spreads out significantly
scenarios.body: The front runners and prominent horses all come back to the hold-up brigade who have been patiently waiting in behind, with Iamagetaway and Oneforgonzo having the class to finish strongly. Kennedy's tactics on Iamagetaway prove decisive as he times his challenge perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If both Butty O Brien and Brave Endeavour fail to maintain their early positions
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy affair with no genuine pace, turning into a sprint finish where any horse with a decent turn of foot can win. This suits the more versatile types who can adapt their running style.

watchPoints.text: Butty O Brien's jumping under pressure - front runners often struggle when headed in handicap chases with this field size
Both Iamagetaway and Ballybrittas disappointed at Kilbeggan recently, so monitor if they've improved for that run
Brave Endeavour's stamina - he fades in the finish and may not last home if he tries to match Butty O Brien early
The reserves Springboard, Brave Endeavour, and Uptaurintop may not all get a run depending on declarations
Sean Flanagan on Kilkee Bay making his chase debut for new connections after 221 days off

races.paceDynamic: What Path will take this field along as the only confirmed front-runner, setting an honest but manageable gallop over this extended trip without early pressure. The prominent runners Journey With Me, Jetoile, Lifetime Ambition and Solitary Man will track within striking distance, while the hold-up brigade including Gin Coco, Tullybeg and several others will need the pace to develop properly in the closing stages. With a single leader and several hold-up horses needing the race to unfold, this tactical setup clearly favours the prominent trackers who can position handy and kick when the pace lifts approaching the business end.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Triumph
scenarios.trigger: If the honest pace allows prominent runners to travel smoothly and respond when the tempo increases
scenarios.body: Journey With Me and Lifetime Ambition can track What Path's measured gallop before asserting their superior class when it matters. Their tactical positioning negates the hold-up horses who need more pace pressure to be effective.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Success
scenarios.trigger: If What Path's gallop becomes too steady and the race develops into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get their ideal scenario with plenty left for a telling late charge. Gin Coco and Tullybeg can unleash their finishing kicks when others have shot their bolt.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Lone Leader Lasts
scenarios.trigger: If What Path gets an easy lead and the chasers fail to organise an effective pursuit
scenarios.body: The front-runner can dictate terms completely and prove hard to peg back despite his moderate profile. His tactical advantage outweighs the class deficit when the pace becomes stop-start.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes messy with fallers or the main fancies underperform
scenarios.body: The second-tier horses can capitalise on a chaotic contest where form goes out the window. Racing luck and a clear run become more valuable than pure ability.

watchPoints.text: What Path getting an uncontested lead could prove hard to peg back if the chasers get organised too late
Journey With Me and Lifetime Ambition must travel smoothly in behind to capitalise on their class advantage
Gin Coco and Tullybeg need the pace to quicken approaching two out to unleash their finishing kicks
Several 7lb claimers aboard means jumping errors more likely in the closing stages
Headcorn returning from long absence makes his fitness levels a major question mark
